subject: Mutual action plan: Sample handback sprint & usage guardrails
messages:
From: Elena Rim <elena.rim@lumencart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Hayes <andrew.hayes@lumencart.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP + sample promptpack for pilot acceptance

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model latency numbers looked promising. Procurement asked that we get a short mutual action plan and the sample artifacts (prompt pack + a small test-case set) before the pilot signature so we can validate acceptance criteria internally.

Can you share:
- A one-page MAP that outlines milestones and owners for the 4-week pilot (ingest -> acceptance -> takedown)
- A small promptpack (<=200 prompts) and a representative test-case bundle we can run in our sandbox
- Any usage constraints / retention / audit requirements we need to agree to (esp. around ephemeral storage and token logging)

We need those by Friday so our security and procurement teams can sign off in time for the June 15 start.

Attachments: none on this message

Thanks,
Elena Rim
Director, Data Science
LumenCart

----
Note: please route MAP to procurement@lumencart.com once finalized
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rim <elena.rim@lumencart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + sample promptpack for pilot acceptance

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide a concise MAP and a gated promptpack bundle for pilot validation. Proposed plan (high level):

- Milestone 1 (Week 0): MAP signed + technical contact set
  - Deliverable: MAP_v1_LumenCart.pdf (owner: Sean) — outlines runbook, canary traffic, rollback criteria
- Milestone 2 (Week 1): Promptpack + test-case bundle delivered to LumenCart sandbox
  - Deliverable: promptpack_v2.zip, usage_matrix.xlsx (owner: Monica) — ephemeral access, sampling plan
- Milestone 3 (Week 2): Acceptance run; joint QA checklist (owner: LumenCart)
- Milestone 4 (Week 3–4): Final acceptance & scheduled takedown; artifacts destroyed per agreement

Key constraints we need you to accept to keep the pilot ephemeral and auditable:
- Test artifacts are provided under a limited-use evaluation license for the duration of the pilot only; no redistribution.
- Redwood will keep call-level logs for 30 days for debugging; you may request an audit extract prior to takedown.
- Promptpack is tagged with provenance headers; any customer-derived PII must be redacted prior to handoff.

I'm attaching the MAP draft and a trimmed promptpack (sample folder index) — full prompt pack will be delivered as a password-protected zip to your sandbox environment. Please confirm procurement contact + whether LumenCart requires an SSA or a separate MSA addendum for evaluation materials.

Attachments:
- MAP_v1_LumenCart.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- promptpack_v2.zip (zip, stub list file included)
- usage_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, pilot acceptance checklist)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Elena / team — quick technical clarifications from infra/security side so the MAP matches what we can operationally deliver: 

- Environment: We will push the promptpack into your sandbox via S3 presigned link; data is accessible only from the sandbox CIDR you provide.
- KV & prefix caching: Redwood will not persist KV caches after takedown; we will flush caches and run a deletion audit script (log excerpt attached).
- Call logs & retention: default 30-day retention for debug logs; we can provide a one-time export for your audit team at Week 3 checkpoint.
- Access controls: Promptpack delivered as encrypted zip; password shared via DocuSign-secured channel or the Redwood console invite.
- PII handling: If LumenCart requires, we can run a redaction pass on sample prompts prior to delivery — this will add one business day to Milestone 2.

Open items (please confirm):
1) Sandbox CIDR range to lock down access
2) Who at procurement will sign the MAP (procurement@lumencart.com?)
3) Any additional retention requirements beyond 30 days

Attachment: deletion_audit_stub.txt (text, 8KB) — contains the record IDs the takedown script would remove (stub).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
